turns.question: Sales year to date compared with the same period last year
turns.resolved: Compare sales from January 1, 2026 through September 27, 2026 with sales from January 1, 2025 through September 27, 2025 for Volume Perf.
turns.sql:
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (
           WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
             AND so.order_date < DATE '2026-09-28'
       ), 0), 2) AS sales_2026_ytd,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (
           WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
             AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-09-28'
       ), 0), 2) AS sales_2025_same_period,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * (
               COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (
                   WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
                     AND so.order_date < DATE '2026-09-28'
               ), 0)
               - COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (
                   WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
                     AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-09-28'
               ), 0)
           )
           / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (
               WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
                 AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-09-28'
           ), 0), 0),
           2
       ) AS growth_pct
FROM sales_orders so
WHERE so.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'CREDIT_BLOCKED')
  AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND so.order_date < DATE '2026-09-28'

turns.question: What was our gross margin percentage in 2025?
turns.resolved: What was Volume Perf's gross margin percentage from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31?
turns.sql:
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(jl.functional_credit_amount - jl.functional_debit_amount)
            FILTER (WHERE a.account_type = 'REVENUE'), 0) AS revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(jl.functional_debit_amount - jl.functional_credit_amount)
            FILTER (WHERE a.id IN (
                SELECT iic.cogs_account_id
                FROM inv_item_categories iic
            )), 0) AS cogs
    FROM fin_journal_lines jl
    JOIN fin_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
    WHERE jl.is_posted
      AND jl.posting_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (t.revenue - t.cogs) / NULLIF(t.revenue, 0), 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals t

           WHERE jl.posting_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
       ), 0), 2) AS revenue_2024,

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (
                 WHERE c.name ILIKE '%volume customer 34%'

                    OR c.name ILIKE '%volume customer 32%'
               ), 0), 2) AS combined_sales,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount), 0), 2) AS total_sales,
